data: The graph represents the results of two different machine translation tasks: IWSLT14 De→En and WMT14 En→De. The x-axis is labeled "lambda," which likely refers to a parameter used in the machine translation model. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU," which stands for Bilingual Evaluation Understudy, a metric used to evaluate the quality of machine translation outputs. The graph shows how the BLEU score changes as the lambda value varies from 0.0 to 1.0. The left graph (a) corresponds to the IWSLT14 De→En task, while the right graph (b) corresponds to the WMT14 En→De task.
